question: The marked price of an article is 160 percent of the cost price. If 35 percent discount is given, then what will be the profit percentage?
solution:
**Given:**

Marked price (MP) = 160% of Cost Price (CP)

Discount = 35%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = MP - (Discount% of MP)

Profit% = ((SP - CP) / CP) × 100

**Calculation:**

Let CP = ₹100

MP = 160% of ₹100

MP = 160

Discount = 35% of ₹160

Discount = 160 × (35 / 100)

Discount = 56

SP = MP - Discount

SP = 160 - 56

SP = 104

Profit% = ((SP - CP) / CP) × 100

Profit% = ((104 - 100) / 100) × 100

Profit% = (4 / 100) × 100

Profit% = 4

**The profit percentage is 4 percent.**
